verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents its own REST API with an OpenAPI spec, OAuth 2.0, file downloads and project-independent resource access, plus official MCP support and a CLI for AI agents. That gives agents a substantial programmatic surface, but nothing in the pack claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a mapping of UI tools (card tables, hill charts, check-ins, timesheets, templates, client mode) to API endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
You can access any resource directly without including its project (bucket) in the URL
Official Basecamp support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support.
CLI access and skills for AI agents you run on your computer.
To download a file, make an authenticated `GET` request to its `download_url` and follow the redirect.
